text: In a small Brazilian town the undertaker Zé do Caixão scorns religion and believes only in [the continuity of his own blood|wants|a child to take or have]. He kills his barren wife Lenita with [a venomous spider|images|vermin and creeping things], murders his friend Antonio and rapes Antonio's fiancée Terezinha, who hangs herself after [vowing to return and take his soul to hell|wants|revenge for a wrong]. The police find nothing against him, but a gypsy warns that [at midnight|rules|death on a deadline] the ghosts of those he murdered will come to claim him.
